id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0917-20261001 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T14:06:29Z"
severity: MINOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex
queue_ref: Q-921  # queue issue_ref ISS-0921 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0950
github_ref: GH-2095
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 4d RELEASE-VALIDATOR. Independently re-derive that ISS-0950's fix is real (do not trust prior reports). On branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001 (main checkout; do not switch; never git checkout/reset): (1) re-run MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/service_catalog/endpoint_url_validation_test.exs test/letflow/webhooks/url_validator_test.exs test/letflow/routers/admin_services_test.exs test/letflow/routers/admin_services_publish_retire_test.exs test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs and quote output; (2) do a live behavioural reproduction of the issue's symptoms via a scratch script or the router test harness: POST /admin/services with http://127.0.0.1/x, https://169.254.169.254/, https://10.0.0.5/, ftp://x, not a url => 422 now; a good https://example.test/path/{{variables.id}} => 201; publish with a bad URL => 422 and no archive row; (3) git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/ confirms ServiceTaskDispatcher and validate/1,2 behaviour unchanged and the diff matches the validated design with no scope creep; (4) check every acceptance point of the issue yaml docs/issues/ISS-0950.yaml (https scheme, host not private/loopback literal at register/publish time; dispatch gate stays binding). Mutants are not needed from you. Do not modify lib/ or test/. Write the result block yourself, COMPLETED, PASS/FAIL. Do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: Live repro of each symptom class quoted

result.summary: Independently re-derived, not copied from TEST-RUNNER. (1) Re-ran MIX_ENV=test mix test on the 5 named files: 'Result: 96 passed', zero failures, no compiler warnings other than pre-existing TenantSchemaReaper log lines. (2) Live repro through the real AdminServices router with a scratch ExUnit file outside the repo (scratchpad/rv_live_test.exs, not committed): POST / with http://127.0.0.1/x, https://169.254.169.254/, https://10.0.0.5/, ftp://x, 'not a url' each -> 422 'validation failed', no service_catalog row created; good https://example.test/path/{{variables.id}} -> 201 echoed verbatim; POST /:id/versions with https://10.0.0.5/, http://x/, 'not a url' each -> 422, service_catalog_versions archive rows = 0, live row's endpoint_url unchanged; a good publish afterwards -> 201. (3) git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/: only service_catalog.ex (docs only, +11), service_catalog/entry.ex (check_endpoint_url/1 + validate_endpoint_url/1 wired into register and publish changesets), webhooks/url_validator.ex (new validate_syntactic/1 and a :no_dns clause in check_host/2) and the design doc. ServiceTaskDispatcher and routers/admin_services.ex are NOT in the diff; validate/1,2 bodies unchanged (the new check_host clause only fires for :no_dns, which validate/1,2 never pass). Diff matches the design; no scope creep. The one existing-test edit (engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs) seeds the legacy templated-host row via Repo.update_all because register now rejects it - justified, engine behaviour under test unchanged. (4) Issue acceptance points: https-only scheme enforced at register and publish; private/loopback/link-local IP-literal hosts rejected at register and publish (incl. effective inherited URL on publish, rollback leaves no archive row); dispatch-time INV-9 gate untouched and still binding. Not run per handoff constraint (scoped tests only): scripts/test_parallel.sh full suite and mix letflow.check.test - ORCH/CI should cover these before merge.
